title: The Big Void as a heat exchanger for reactions in the Grand Gallery

tellings.quote: For example, the big void, it's in a perfect location for a heat exchanger.

plain: The Big Void, a large empty space found inside Egypt's Great Pyramid, sits in a perfect spot to work as a heat exchanger, a device that carries heat away, for reactions taking place in the Grand Gallery, the tall sloping passage inside the pyramid. The researcher Jeffrey Drum offers this as his own idea, naming no source, as part of his case that the pyramid was a machine rather than a tomb.
